organicTrafficScore.statDaysExtra: Calculate within this day range; leave empty for unlimited
organicTrafficScore.rule1: Organic traffic does not sell slots. All eligible merchants in the same slot rank by composite score, higher score = higher ranking.
organicTrafficScore.rule2: Composite score = Σ (dimension weight × dimension score rate), where score rate = sum of enabled rule scores ÷ sum of enabled rule max scores.
organicTrafficScore.rule3: Deduction rules have negative scores; when triggered, they directly deduct from the dimension score. Disabled rules do not participate in calculation or count toward the max score denominator.
organicTrafficScore.rule5: Scores are recalculated periodically by the system. Tied merchants are compared by "store rating → recent 30-day orders → distance".
organicTrafficScore.rule6: Built-in rules cannot be deleted; only editing, adjusting scores, and enabling/disabling are allowed. Custom rules can be deleted.

recommend.randomStrategyDesc: System auto-collects merchants who purchased ads in each region, generates merchant ID list for random display. New purchasing merchants are auto-added; removed merchants are auto-excluded.
recommend.roundRobinStrategyDesc: System auto-collects merchants who purchased ads in each region, generates merchant ID list in order, then displays them one by one in rotation, ensuring equal exposure for each ad merchant in the same region. New merchants are auto-added; removed merchants are auto-excluded, with subsequent merchants filling in.
recommend.newStoreRoundRobinDesc: System auto-collects merchants within new store cycles in each region, generates merchant ID list in order, then displays them one by one in rotation, ensuring equal exposure for each new store merchant. Newly opened merchants are auto-added; merchants whose cycle ends or who stop promotion are auto-excluded, with subsequent merchants filling in.
recommend.dimensionHint: (At least one; multiple items can set weights, higher weight gets priority exposure)
recommend.bayesianAlpha: α: Fixed value 5, preset completed orders
recommend.bayesianBeta: β: Fixed value 10, preset total orders
recommend.bayesianEffect: Effect: Fewer orders pull completion rate toward 50%, avoiding small sample bias
recommend.bayesianLargeVolume: More orders: adjusted rate approaches real completion rate
recommend.distanceFar: Farther distance: score exponentially decays toward 0
recommend.distanceCoeff: Decay coefficient 0.1: every 10km increase, score drops ~63%
recommend.finalScoreFormula: Final Score = (Quality/5 × W₁) + (Adj. Rate × W₂) + (Support × W₃) + (Distance × W₄)
recommend.supportScoreFormula: Support = max(0, (8-first days)/7); Distance = e^(-0.1×distance km)
recommend.exampleWeight: Assume weights: W₁=6, W₂=3, W₃=1, W₄=4 (α=5, β=10 fixed)
recommend.exposureStrategyDesc: In single-slot scenario, each user request triggers weighted random selection by merchant score. Higher scores have higher probability, but lower-scored merchants also get exposure.
